title: Top2 Inhibitor Sensitivity Assay
author: Jacob G Kirkland
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k5zcy76
materials: 48:00:00 Incubate cells with Top2i for 2 days

steps.title: Seed and Attach Cells
steps.instruction: Plate cells in two 6cm dishes at 25% confluency (approximately 500K cells) and allow them to attach overnight.

steps.title: Induce Cells with Doxycycline
steps.instruction: Induce one plate of cells for 72 hours using 1000x Doxycycline in fresh media.

substeps.instruction: Change media with fresh Doxycycline daily for the induced plate.
Change media for the corresponding non-induced plate every 72 hours.

steps.title: Split and Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Split cells at a density appropriate for the cell type (e.g., 5000K cells/well) in a total volume of 150ul media per well.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mixes of cells/well in 50ml conical tubes.
Distribute the mix using a multi-channel pipette.
Add Doxycycline to induced samples at 500x concentration.

steps.title: Prepare Top2i Dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute Top2i in media within a 96-well round bottom plate for transfer to cell plates, using media without Doxycycline.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ul of stock concentration drug to 250ul of media (1:125 dilution).
Note: Adding 50ul of this dilution to the 150ul already in the well results in a 1:500 final dilution.

steps.title: Perform Cell Titer Blue Assay
steps.instruction: Add Cell Titer Blue to the wells to measure viability.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Cell Titer Blue 1:2 in PBS.
Add 20ul of the diluted Cell Titer Blue to each well.

steps.title: Read Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to 384-well black plates for reading.
